entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3815937670648091392: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.5942 +/- 0.0189 mas (same row, RUWE 0.82): 178.76 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -49.326, 0.114 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.852 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract). Mass 0.864 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract). Temperature 5183 +/- 125 K from Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,183 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe9d6. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,183 K and log g 4.51 (u1 0.605, u2 0.160): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
